description: Test script for VAT audit report in ERPNext, including setup functions for company, accounts, items, customers, suppliers, invoices, and a test case for VAT audit report validation.

classes.name: TestVATAuditReport
classes.description: Unit test case for VAT audit report, including setup and validation of VAT calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates company, accounts, items, customer, supplier, invoices.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test data from database.

methods.name: test_vat_audit_report
methods.description: Executes VAT audit report and verifies total tax amounts match.

methods.name: make_company
methods.description: Creates a new company with default settings if it does not exist.

methods.name: set_sa_vat_accounts
methods.description: Sets South Africa VAT accounts for the test company if not already set.

methods.name: make_customer
methods.description: Creates a test customer if not exists.

methods.name: make_supplier
methods.description: Creates a test supplier if not exists.

methods.name: make_item
methods.description: Creates a test item with optional properties.

methods.name: make_sales_invoices
methods.description: Creates sample sales invoices with VAT and zero-rated items.

methods.name: create_purchase_invoices
methods.description: Creates a sample purchase invoice with VAT.
